welcome:
✨ *Welcome to Give Me Word!* ✨

I'm here to help you read through scripture daily at your own pace.

Let's get you set up!
choose_bible_version:
📖 Which Bible version would you like?

🇪🇹 *Amharic* — ትግሪትና ምሳሌዎች በአማርኛ
🇬🇧 *KJV* — King James Version (English)
📘 *Amplified* — Amplified Bible (English)
choose_commitment:
📖 Choose your commitment level (1-5):

*Level 1* — 1 reading track per day
*Level 2* — 2 reading tracks per day
*Level 3* — 3 reading tracks per day
*Level 4* — 4 reading tracks per day
*Level 5* — 5 reading tracks per day
commitment_set:
✅ Commitment level set to *{{level}}*.
You have *{{level}}* active reading slot(s).
choose_delivery_time:
⏰ When would you like to receive your daily reading?

Send me a time in 24-hour format like `07:00` (7:00 AM) or `20:30` (8:30 PM).

*Note: Times are in UTC+3 (Ethiopia time)*
setup_complete:
🎉 *You're all set!*

Your first reading will be sent at {{time}}. You can also use /read to get today's reading anytime.

Commands:
/read — Get your current reading
/next — Advance to next reading
/settings — Change preferences
/help — All commands
/streak — Your reading streak
help:
📚 *Give Me Word — Commands*

/start — Start or restart setup
/read — Get your current reading immediately
/next — Advance to the next reading
/settings — View and change preferences
/streak — View your reading streak
/test_deliver — Send a test delivery (for testing)
/help — Show this help message
settings_menu:
⚙️ *Your Settings*

🌍 Language: *{{language}}*
📖 Bible: *{{bible}}*
📚 Level: *{{level}}* tracks
⏰ Delivery Time: *{{time}}* (UTC+3)
🕐 Timezone: *{{timezone}}*
reading_footer:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📊 Slot {{slot}} of {{total}} | {{mode}} mode

Use /next to continue reading.
no_active_tracks:
You don't have any active reading tracks yet.
Use /start to set up your first track!
streak_info:
🔥 *Your Reading Streak*

📅 Current: *{{current}}* days
🏆 Longest: *{{longest}}* days
📖 Last read: *{{lastDate}}*
invalid_time:
❌ Please send a valid time in HH:MM format (e.g. `07:00`).

*Accepted format:*
- `07:00` for 7:00 AM
- `20:30` for 8:30 PM
error_generic: ❌ Something went wrong. Please try again.
